note: quince#306, the CONTROL, and it is the half that makes the diagnosis a mechanism rather than a story. Same session, same tool, 70 minutes later, and the opposite output: #296 baselined silently. The difference is not the declaration and not the comment's age — the comment here is deliberately SEVEN HOURS OLD, the same as its partner fixture's — it is that this issue was not in the previous observation at all. `select($o == null)` is the whole condition. So the two behaviours r4 could not reconcile are one rule applied to two prior states, and the pair is written to hold every other variable fixed: same day, same declaration, same stale comment, differing only in whether the issue was already being watched. Without this file the partner fixture would pass against a build that emitted comment events for every newly declared issue, which is precisely the defect r4 suspected and could not rule out.
